mara_formal.excerpt: I would prefer to review the figures before we announce a decision. Please wait until the ledger has been checked in full.
The evidence is incomplete, and I will not ask anyone to act on a guess. We can speak again when the report arrives.
If you have a concern, state it plainly and give me time to consider it. A careful answer is better than a quick one.

arin_narrator.excerpt: I carried the blue notebook through the station after the rain. The platform was empty, and I could hear the clock ticking above the ticket window. I wanted to ask for help, but I kept walking because the last train had already left.

I returned to the narrow street before sunrise and found the shop shutters closed. My shoes were wet from the stones, and I wondered whether the baker had seen the note I left beneath the door. I waited there until the lamps went out.

I had promised to tell the truth when we reached the harbor. By then the wind had scattered the papers across the quay, and I could not remember which page held the date. I folded what remained and carried it home without showing anyone.

madame_arlen.excerpt: Please place the letters on my desk before noon. I will read each one after the morning meeting has finished.
I remember the old garden quite clearly. The gate was green then, and the roses grew along the western wall.
You may ask me about the estate, but I cannot speak for my husband. His records are kept in a separate room.

monsieur_arlen.excerpt: The north gate is my responsibility. Send the surveyors there, and do not move the equipment until I return.
I signed the repair order yesterday. If the hinges fail again, bring the invoice directly to my office.
My wife keeps the household letters. I handle the grounds and the accounts for the western fields.

elin_formal.excerpt: I should like to inspect the map before anyone crosses the river. We need to know where the bridge still stands.
The report deserves a careful reading. Please do not mistake a convenient answer for a reliable one.
I will speak when the witnesses have arrived. Until then, the matter should remain open to question.

noor_bilingual.excerpt: I tell my grandmother, despacio, because the steps are steep. With the survey team I use their English place names.
The market women call that lane la cuesta. I translate it as the hill road when I write the field notes.
At home I say buenos días to my brother. At work I greet the inspectors in English so they know I am addressing them.

cases.submitted_text: I walked to the harbor before dawn and found the blue notebook where I had left it. The pages were dry, but the wind had turned the cover inside out. I carried it beneath my coat and did not tell anyone what I had found. Later I thought, this whole mystery was totally bogus, and I laughed at the words because they did not sound like mine.
